High-grossing films by year [![A portrait of a bespectacled middle aged man.](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/67/Steven_Spielberg_by_Gage_Skidmore.jpg/250px-Steven_Spielberg_by_Gage_Skidmore.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Steven_Spielberg_by_Gage_Skidmore.jpg) Films directed by Steven Spielberg have been the highest-grossing film of the year on five occasions, and on three occasions have been the highest-grossing film of all time. The 1970s saw a shift in audience tastes to [high concept](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/High_concept) films, with five such films made by either [George Lucas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Lucas) or [Steven Spielberg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steven_Spielberg) topping the chart during the 1980s. Steven Spielberg (1975, 1981, 1982, 1989 and 1993) and [Cecil B. DeMille](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cecil_B._DeMille) (1932, 1947, 1949, 1952 and 1956) tie as the most represented directors on the chart with five films apiece occupying the annual top spot. [William Wyler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Wyler) (1942, 1946, 1959 and 1968) and [James Cameron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Cameron) (1991, 1997, 2009 and 2022) are each represented by four films, whilst [D. W. Griffith](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D._W._Griffith) (1915, 1916 and 1920), [George Roy Hill](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Roy_Hill) (1966, 1969 and 1973) and the [Russo brothers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russo_brothers) (2016, 2018 and 2019) all feature heavily with three films apiece. George Lucas directed three chart-toppers in 1977, 1999 and 2005, but also served in a strong creative capacity as a producer and writer in 1980, 1981, 1983, and 1989 as well. The following directors have also all directed two films on the chart: [Frank Lloyd](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frank_Lloyd), [King Vidor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King_Vidor), [Frank Capra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frank_Capra), [Michael Curtiz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Curtiz), [Leo McCarey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leo_McCarey), [Alfred Hitchcock](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alfred_Hitchcock), [David Lean](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Lean), [Stanley Kubrick](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stanley_Kubrick), [Guy Hamilton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guy_Hamilton), [Mike Nichols](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mike_Nichols), [William Friedkin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/William_Friedkin), [Peter Jackson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peter_Jackson), [Gore Verbinski](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gore_Verbinski), and [Michael Bay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay); [Mervyn LeRoy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mervyn_LeRoy), [Ken Annakin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ken_Annakin) and [Robert Wise](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Wise) are each represented by one solo credit and one shared credit, and [John Ford](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Ford) co-directed two films. Disney films are usually co-directed and some directors have served on several winning teams: [Wilfred Jackson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wilfred_Jackson), [Hamilton Luske](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hamilton_Luske), [Clyde Geronimi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clyde_Geronimi), [David Hand](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Hand_(animator)), [Ben Sharpsteen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ben_Sharpsteen), [Wolfgang Reitherman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wolfgang_Reitherman) and Bill Roberts have all co-directed at least two films on the list. # The Best Film Directors of All Time, Ranked by Box Office Gross
## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **1. Steven Spielberg ($10.72 billion)**
Even if money had nothing to do with it, Steven Spielberg is one of the most influential figures in modern Hollywood. He mastered the art of the summer blockbuster with _Jaws_ in 1975, which made him a household name. _Close Encounters of the Third Kind_, _E.T._ _The Extra-Terrestrial_ and the [_Indiana Jones_](https://www.directv.com/insider/indiana-jones-in-order/) series followed one right after another.

Spielberg delivered one of the most iconic science fiction hits in _[Jurassic Park](https://www.directv.com/insider/jurassic-park-movies-in-order/)_, which became the highest-grossing film ever at the time and drove record ticket sales worldwide. He followed that up with _Schindler’s List_, which won him the Academy Award for best director. He won it again for _Saving Private Ryan_ just a few years later.

Across more than 100 feature films, Spielberg often alternates between epic sci-fi stories like _A.I._ _Artificial Intelligence_, _Minority Report_, _War of the Worlds_ and _Ready Player One_ with ambitious historical dramas rich in story, be it _Amistad_, _War Horse_, _Lincoln_ or _The Post_. He’s had comedies like _Catch Me If You Can_. He’s dipped into animation with _The Adventures of Tintin_ and even the musical world with _West Side Story_.

His career is so fascinating it spawned a semi-autobiographical film in _The Fabelmans_ in 2022.

**Steven Spielberg’s highest-grossing film:** [_Jurassic Park_](https://www.directv.com/guide/movies/Jurassic-Park-aee6dd65-c9ae-f5f9-8cea-f9ee2b411982) at $1.1 billion worldwide.

### **2. James Cameron ($9.8 billion)**
Cameron made his mark on Hollywood in the mid-1980s with _The Terminator_, followed by [_Aliens_](https://www.directv.com/insider/alien-movies-ranked/), _Terminator 2_ and _True Lies_. Cameron often tells the stories of humanity versus nature and technology.

Cameron’s true breakthrough came with _Titanic_, which in 1999 became the highest-grossing film of all time and won him an Academy Award.

But it is the _Avatar_ movies that have elevated him to a new level of ambitious filmmaking. Cameron has three of the top four highest-grossing films of all time. _Avatar_ is number one, _Avatar: The Way of Water_ is number three and _Titanic_ is number four.

**James Cameron’s highest-grossing film: _[Avatar](https://www.directv.com/guide/movies/Avatar-854afec3-8d7f-a5e4-459d-3e88e9ecf972)_** at $2.9 billion worldwide.

### **4. Peter Jackson ($6.55 billion)**
Peter Jackson rose to global stardom by directing [_The Lord of the Rings_ trilogy](https://www.directv.com/insider/lord-of-the-rings-in-order/) and then ultimately _The Hobbit_ trilogy.

_The Lord of the Rings_ became a worldwide sensation, and _The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_ set a record for Academy Awards won, including three by Jackson himself for best picture, best director and best adapted screenplay.

Jackson also went on to direct the Beatles documentary _Get Back_ and is slated to direct the currently untitled _Adventures of Tintin_ sequel.

**Peter Jackson’s highest-grossing film:** [_The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_](https://www.directv.com/guide/movies/The-Lord-of-the-Rings:-The-Return-of-the-King-90bbc06c-e555-fbc1-6a7b-7dc830911751) at $1.12 billion.

### **5. Michael Bay ($6.5 billion)**
If there’s one word to describe Michael Bay as a filmmaker, it’s explosive. The Los Angeles native has moviemaking in his bones and is behind the camera of some of the most entertaining action movies of the mid-1990s and early 2000s.

With fast cuts and no shortage of special effects, Bay has directed _Bad Boys_, _Bad Boys II_, _Armageddon_, _Pearl Harbor_, _Pain & Gain_ and as of 2022, _Ambulance_.

But one universe he stayed in more than any other is _Transformers_. He’s directed five of the _Transformers_ films since its release in 2007.

**Michael Bay’s highest-grossing film:** [_Transformers: Dark of the Moon_](https://www.directv.com/guide/movies/Transformers:-Dark-of-the-Moon-cab9cdd2-1b73-5ded-dbbb-84d5b914e3fa) at $1.1 billion.

### **7. Christopher Nolan ($6.35 billion)**
[Chrispher Nolan](https://www.directv.com/insider/christopher-nolan-movies-ranked/) is perhaps the most influential director of the 21st century. He burst onto the scene with _The Dark Knight_ trilogy, _The Prestige_ and _Inception_ within seven years, and has since followed up with high-concept sci-fi films like [_Interstellar_](https://www.directv.com/insider/movies-like-interstellar/) and _Tenet_ and ambitious historical dramas in _Dunkirk_ and _[Oppenheimer](https://www.directv.com/insider/oppenheimer-everything-you-missed-the-first-time/)_.

But all of that previous ambition pales in comparison to his greatest epic yet, _[The Odyssey](https://www.directv.com/insider/the-odyssey-nolan-cast/)_, the retelling of Homer’s epic, released in theaters July 17, 2026. Nolan’s adaptation delivered the biggest opening of his career, earning $264.1 million worldwide in its debut weekend.

**Christopher Nolan’s highest-grossing film:** [_The Dark Knight Rises_,](https://www.directv.com/guide/movies/The-Dark-Knight-Rises-bd0da5d6-65ee-729c-c03f-c5d3d7507e14) which earned more than $1 billion at the box office.

### **10. J.J. Abrams ($4.64 billion)**
J.J. Abrams became a go-to man in Hollywood with the massive success of _Lost_, which was the show of the early 2000s.

His first major film directorial job was _Mission: Impossible III_, which is when the series took a massive leap in production, before helping to revive the _Star Trek_ film series.

Abrams was then tasked to revive the [_Star Wars_ film series](https://www.directv.com/insider/the-best-order-to-watch-all-the-star-wars-movies/), and _Star Wars: Episode VII – The Force Awakens_ remains his highest-grossing film of all time and top five overall.

**J.J.** **Abrams’s highest-grossing film:** [_Star Wars: Episode VII – The Force Awakens_](https://www.directv.com/guide/movies/Star-Wars:-The-Force-Awakens-d8a2a084-2dda-2fea-3e23-9163eec35882) at $2.07 billion worldwide.

### **12. Jon Favreau ($4.34 billion)**
Favreau got his start as an actor, breaking through with his role in _Swingers_. But he made his mark as a director with two very different films.

The first was _Elf_ in 2003, which remains a holiday classic. And then came _Iron Man_ and _Iron Man 2_, which helped kick off the Marvel Cinematic Universe and made him one of the most influential figures in that franchise.

Favreau made his own personal passion project in _Chef_ before finding his way into remakes of Disney classics in _The Jungle Book_ and _The Lion King_.

Favreau’s most recent endeavor as a director has been _The Mandalorian_ TV series and the new _Star Wars: The Mandalorian & Grogu_ film, which hit theaters in May 2026.

**Jon Favreau’s highest-grossing film:** [_The Lion King_](https://www.directv.com/guide/movies/The-Lion-King-b4722510-17bd-6ea2-95a7-9a8ae713f4b7) at $1.66 billion worldwide.

### **13. Ron Howard ($4.31 billion)**
Ron Howard has been an influential part of Hollywood since the late 1960s as an actor in _The Andy Griffith Show_ and _Happy Days_.

As a director, _Apollo 13_ made him a directorial household name. _A Beautiful Mind_, _Cinderella Man_ and _How the Grinch Stole Christmas_ showed off his versatility as a director among multiple genres.

**Ron Howard’s highest-grossing film:** [_The Da Vinci Code_](https://www.directv.com/guide/movies/The-Da-Vinci-Code:-Extended-Cut-cc1c0905-44a8-4982-32d3-caea211aa500), which earned $758 million worldwide.

## Frequently asked questions
#### Who is the all-time top-grossing director?
Steven Spielberg is the highest-grossing director in history.

#### Who are the top five highest-grossing directors?
Steven Spielberg, James Cameron, The Russo Brothers, Michael Bay and Peter Jackson are the top five top-grossing directors of all time.
